raw_response:
Useful existing mechanisms for the Python annotation problem

I found six candidates. Five have versioned or dated evidence before the 2017-12-04 cutoff; the stub-file candidate has only live behavioral documentation with an unverified historical date. These are components and transfer ideas, not claims that any proposal adopted them or that they were proved useful.

1. CPython 3.6.3 _ForwardRef and get_type_hints
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/python/cpython/v3.6.3/Lib/typing.py
Its existing string-to-code wrapper and explicit namespace resolver provide a concrete component for resolving annotation names after their definitions exist.
Use it to study representation, namespace selection, and delayed evaluation. It still requires quoted expressions, retains compilation work, and validates results as types; preserving arbitrary annotation values would require a more general evaluation path. The matching 3.6.3 documentation is dated 2017-10-03.

2. SQLAlchemy 1.1.15 deferred relationship arguments
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/rel_1_1_15/lib/sqlalchemy/orm/relationships.py
Its delayed callable and registry-backed string resolution show how Python declarations can refer to later-defined classes and compute configuration when a consumer first needs it.
The useful transfer is an explicit resolution lifecycle and namespace. The ORM's registry, accepted values, and initialization rules are domain-specific; Python annotations would need their own scope and error-timing contract. The tagged changelog dates this version to 2017-11-03.

3. SRFI 45 delay, lazy, and force
https://srfi.schemers.org/srfi-45/srfi-45.html
Its promises defer arbitrary expressions and memoize their results, offering a general annotation-value mechanism that can avoid import-time execution while retaining non-type uses.
This is a mechanism to translate from Scheme. Environment lifetime, side effects, cycles, and exceptions need explicit Python semantics; deferred computation also has representation costs. The source records finalization on 2004-04-05 and a 2004-08-04 bug fix.

4. Angular 4.4.6 forwardRef and resolveForwardRef
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/angular/angular/4.4.6/packages/core/src/di/forward_ref.ts
Its marked zero-argument callback defers reference lookup and its resolver passes ordinary values through, providing a small explicit opt-in pattern for forward references.
It offers a concrete callback representation, but requires wrappers and does not memoize results. Lookup must occur after the binding exists, and transferring it into Python requires scope and syntax decisions. The matching changelog dates version 4.4.6 to 2017-10-18.

5. Python 3.6.3 TYPE_CHECKING import guards
https://docs.python.org/release/3.6.3/library/typing.html#typing.TYPE_CHECKING
This existing checker-only branch mechanism can keep dependencies needed solely for type descriptions from being imported during ordinary execution.
It complements deferred references but does not eliminate quoting or make omitted dependencies available to runtime consumers. Arbitrary runtime annotation metadata still needs its own evaluation path. The versioned documentation was last updated on 2017-10-03.

6. Mypy .pyi stub files
https://mypy.readthedocs.io/en/latest/stubs.html
Separate type-interface files offer a tooling-only route to keep type descriptions outside executable module bodies while preserving optional checking.
This is a partial alternative: it duplicates interfaces and does not supply arbitrary runtime annotation metadata. Historical behavioral verification is incomplete: the current page was opened, but the attempted 0.550 documentation URLs failed. The 2017-11-10 package release timestamp does not establish the date of the live documentation.

The central design distinction is between delaying evaluation while retaining runtime metadata and moving static descriptions out of executable code. For either route, optional type checking and arbitrary annotation consumers need separate consideration. No implementation or benchmark was run.

Public GitHub code was also searched through the web and versioned raw source was opened directly. Two target-related search snippets were recorded and excluded; no target document was opened.
